about.heading: Igniting the genius in every child.
about.p1: Zeal Care is a nonprofit organization headquartered in Monrovia, Liberia. We are dedicated to empowering Africa's future leaders through comprehensive education, focused mentorship, and crucial technology access.
about.p2: We have partnered with local communities — including Esfans Academy at West Point Zone 405 — to break down barriers to success. We don't just provide resources; we build pathways for children to discover their potential and transform their communities.
about.quote: When you give a child the right tools and someone who believes in them, their potential is limitless.

faq.title: Giving FAQ
faq.hero: Find answers to all your questions about Zeal Care and donating.

items.a: Zeal Care is a nonprofit NGO that empowers underprivileged children between the ages of 4 and 17 from low-income backgrounds to foster academic success, social confidence, and emotional well-being. The organization is committed to inclusivity and transformation to create opportunities, uplift lives, and inspire hope for a brighter and more equitable future.

items.q: How can I learn more about Zeal Care's impact?
items.a: You can stay updated on our work by exploring our website, following us on social media, or signing up for our newsletter. We regularly share updates on our ongoing projects, success stories, and community initiatives.

items.q: Where does Zeal Care's funding come from?
items.a: Our funding comes from generous donations by individuals, organizations, and partners who believe in our mission. We ensure that every contribution directly benefits the people and communities we serve.

items.q: Can I donate to support a specific county or program?
items.a: Yes, you can do this in one of two ways: donate to a specific initiative or appeal on this page, or include a note with your donation specifying the county or program. We are always happy to answer any questions about how we ensure that your funds reach the programs and/or counties you specify.

items.q: Can I volunteer or travel with Zeal Care?
items.a: Yes! We welcome volunteers who are passionate and willing to create change. If you'd like to contribute your skills, reach out to us at zealcare24@gmail.com or info@zealcare.org.

items.q: Can my organization partner with Zeal Care?
items.a: Yes! We actively seek partnerships with organizations, businesses, and institutions that align with our mission, vision, and programs. If you are interested in collaborating, email us at info@zealcare.org.
Zeal Care is based in Monrovia, Liberia. We are committed to driving impactful change across Liberia and beyond borders through our various programs.

Every donation is allocated to key impact areas such as full education sponsorship, leadership & entrepreneurship training, digital literacy skills training, workshops to help make a choice of a career path in STEM, and other impactful community initiatives. We are committed to transparency in fund allocation.

items.q: Can I make a gift by wire transfer?
items.a: Yes! Please contact our team at info@zealcare.org, and we'll send you instructions on how to make those gifts or visit our donation and igniting potential pages.

items.q: How can I get a receipt for tax purposes?
items.a: For online donations, the acknowledgment you receive via email serves as your receipt for tax purposes. For donations made by other means, the acknowledgment sent to you by post or email serves as your receipt. To request a duplicate receipt, please email info@zealcare.org with details.

items.q: Does Zeal Care share my information?
items.a: In keeping with our privacy policy, we do not transmit, transfer, or sell private information to any outside parties.

items.q: Do you accept donations of books, school supplies, clothes, or other materials outside of Liberia?
items.a: While we appreciate offers to support Zeal Care's educational initiative with supplies, we are unable to accept these kinds of gifts. Zeal Care avoids overhead and administrative costs associated with shipping donated goods. Instead, we appreciate cash transfers directly, so that our procurement and logistics team can buy the supplies children need. This policy also helps us support local businesses in Liberia and Africa.

items.q: Are there any health requirements for traveling to Liberia?
items.a: Yes! A yellow fever vaccination is required for entry into Liberia. We also recommend taking anti-malarial medication and consulting with a doctor before traveling.

items.q: How can I stay connected with Zeal Care?
items.a: You can follow us on social media (LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram) and subscribe to our newsletter for regular updates. Links are available in our website footer.
